$comment: Hard limits enforced by tools/vitest/budgetReporter.mjs on every run. Per-file and per-test limits sit at about twice the current worst case; suite totals may exceed the baseline by the tolerance. Totals are per-file sums (not wall clock) but still swing ~1.5x with machine load, so the gate is tuned to catch a doubling, not drift. Refresh the baseline here, in the same change, when the suite legitimately grows. Refreshed 2026-08-29 against measured totals; the previous numbers dated from before this branch and could not be reconciled — the single per-test offender is baselineSchema's idempotency check at ~21s, which no change in the thread-references range plausibly accounts for.
